name: Approval without vote
title: RECOMMENDATION for second reading on the Council position at first reading with a view to the adoption of a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directive 2008/98/EC on waste
part_text:
The European Parliament has approved the Council's position on new rules amending the EU waste directive. This follows an agreement reached between Parliament and the Council in negotiations. The report itself does not spell out the detailed content of the changes; it confirms that Parliament accepts the agreed text and that the act is adopted. Parliament's President will now sign it, and it will be published in the Official Journal.

- The EU waste directive is being amended, but the report does not list the specific changes.
- The rules will apply across the EU once the agreed text becomes law.
- Parliament's President and the Council will sign it, then it is published.
